description: Score one lat/lon 0-100 using only measured factors (power and grid, fiber, natural-hazard risk, water), with a BUILD/CAUTION/AVOID verdict and a coverage map of which factors were measured. Needs a DC Hub account with site-analysis access; without one it returns only a notice.

lat.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90, required), e.g. 33.45

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

lon.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, required), e.g. -112.07

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

state.description: US state abbreviation (optional) — improves water/context lookups, e.g. AZ

name: get_composite_site_score
title: Get Composite Site Score
